verdict.rationale: Pigment's security page documents testing environments where modellers can plan and stage changes before they are pushed to production. That is a first-party, isolated non-production environment, not just a dry-run preview. The only evidence is a single marketing-level mention, with nothing on how the environment is isolated from production data or whether AI agents can target it. Missing for 10: documentation that sandbox data is separated from production data, a way to point the MCP server or agents at the test environment, how environments are created and promoted, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data

citations.quote: testing environments that allow your modellers to plan and stage changes before being pushed into the production application.
